bias.label: Leaning down below 3,745; small bounce after the Fed-minutes low

event: US jobless claims and Philly Fed index Thu 19 Nov 15:30 SAST, then Fed Hammack 15:50 SAST (Finviz calendar).

bullets.title: Small Asian bounce
bullets.text: Spot gold was near 3,735 early on Thursday in Asia, a little above Wednesday's low of 3,719.55 (exact quote time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Wednesday was heavy
bullets.text: Gold fell about 3.2% on Wednesday to its lowest level since September 2025 after the hawkish Fed minutes.

bullets.title: Minutes were hawkish
bullets.text: Some Fed officials argued for a hike in October, and most see inflation risks from energy prices.

bullets.title: Hike still expected
bullets.text: FedWatch shows about 90% odds of a quarter-point hike in December and about 10% for a half-point hike, though sources differ.

bullets.title: Dollar at 19-month high
bullets.text: The dollar strengthened to a fresh 19-month high and yields rose; the latest index and yield values are UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: Busy US afternoon
bullets.text: Jobless claims and the Philly Fed index land at 15:30 SAST, with several Fed speakers later, so expect fast moves.

bullets.title: Oversold but trending
bullets.text: RSI is about 31 after a drop of more than 8% in a week, so sharp bounces can happen inside the downtrend.
